title: 10-layer ZnS/ZnSe stack with expanded thickness bounds for LWIR quarter-wave compatibility
scientific_hypothesis: Expanding thickness bounds from 850nm to 2000nm will enable quarter-wave optical thicknesses at LWIR center wavelength (~9500nm), resolving material_data failures and improving target score beyond 0.2961.
design_principle: Quarter-wave stack design with optical thickness λ/4 at 9500nm center wavelength. For n≈2.3, physical thickness ≈1035nm. Bounds 100-2000nm accommodate this while allowing optimization freedom.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | Ge substrate (10 finite layers)
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness bounds compatible with thermal evaporation deposition
theory_basis: Quarter-wave stack theory for dichroic filter design
TMM coherent summation for multilayer interference
expected_advantages: Expanded bounds accommodate LWIR quarter-wave thicknesses
Reduced layer count may improve optimization convergence
Alternating high/low index provides strong spectral contrast
known_risks: Material refractive index data availability at 3000-11000nm range
10 layers may provide insufficient spectral selectivity vs 12-layer prior designs
execution_request_english: Design a 10-layer planar multilayer dielectric film on Ge substrate with air incidence. Layer sequence: ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe, ZnS, ZnSe (10 finite layers total). All layer thicknesses are optimizable variables with bounds 100-2000nm. Wavelength range 3000-11000nm sampled at 2001 points. Target: maximize transmittance in 8000-11000nm band, minimize transmittance in 3000-5000nm band. Use coherent TMM solver. Initialize thicknesses at 1000nm for all layers. Apply gradient_thickness and differential_evolution_thickness optimizers. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Expanded thickness bounds from 850nm to 2000nm to accommodate quarter-wave optical thickness at LWIR wavelengths. Reduced layer count from 12 to 10 to test if fewer layers improve optimization convergence while maintaining spectral performance.
